issues.description: The problem text (lines 49-51) instructs students to implement addGuestStudents(String), but the UML diagram and the reference solution define addGuestStudents(int): void. This parameter type mismatch can lead students to implement the wrong method signature and fail compilation/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the problem statement with the UML and solution by changing the text to require addGuestStudents(int). Alternatively, if a String parameter was intended, update the UML and solution to use String consistently.
